name: Dashboard, navigation and command menu
acceptance_criteria: Navigate Home, Library, Discover, Custom AI, Publish, Chats, boards and spaces; Cmd/Ctrl-K searches and creates items; pinned and recent items reopen correctly.

name: Isolated workspaces and membership
acceptance_criteria: A user switches workspaces; boards, notes, chats, social accounts, connectors and tokens never leak between tenants; member access is checked on every API and shared item.

name: Multiple brands and pooled allowances
acceptance_criteria: Separate brands have their own connected accounts, queue and schedules; multi-workspace plan pools credits, seats and social sets; changing brand changes scope everywhere.

name: Quick capture
acceptance_criteria: Cmd/Ctrl-K capture supports sticky card, markdown document, URL preview and multi-file uploads; chosen board is remembered; changing destination does not save; repeated capture and recent captures work.

name: Pinned items
acceptance_criteria: Pin/unpin frequently used items and open from navigation; persistent per-user/workspace state.

name: Onboarding and topic preferences
acceptance_criteria: Guided first board, own accounts, niche/topic pillars and workspace defaults persist and feed research views.

name: Unified saved item library
acceptance_criteria: Create and browse documents, sticky cards, links, PDFs, images, audio/video, EPUBs, saved social posts and highlights; item has stable identity independent of boards.

name: Type, source, tags and topic filters
acceptance_criteria: Combinable filters narrow library by item type, source, platform, topic and tags; switching grid/list retains relevant state and opens selected item.

name: Keyword and semantic search
acceptance_criteria: Find exact text and conceptually related notes/highlights/PDFs/links/posts, with source links; queries cannot surface another tenant’s private items.

name: Workspace tags
acceptance_criteria: Create, rename, recolor, assign, remove and filter shared workspace tags across supported item types.

name: Connections and bidirectional links
acceptance_criteria: Connect any two items; both show relationship; inline @ mentions create durable connections; deleting a view does not corrupt original item.

name: Graph view and entity hubs
acceptance_criteria: Show item nodes linked through books, creators, boards and extracted entities; hub focus, zoom and type toggles work; new items enrich automatically.

name: Neural relations while writing
acceptance_criteria: Current paragraph returns semantically relevant owned items with debounce; excludes already mentioned items; per-type preference; inserting suggestion is explicit and links items.

name: Source assignment and enrichment
acceptance_criteria: Saved items retain source URL, creator, title, date, platform and media metadata; source grouping survives board placement.

name: Notes on saved items
acceptance_criteria: Write and persist personal/workspace notes attached to original social/link/media item, independently of which board displays it.

name: RSS subscriptions
acceptance_criteria: Add valid feed, ingest new entries, avoid duplicates, show source/feed filtering and unsubscribe without corrupting already saved work.

name: Notion export import
acceptance_criteria: Import supported Notion export archive into notes/library, preserve supported hierarchy, attachments and links; report unsupported entries.

name: Obsidian vault import
acceptance_criteria: Import markdown vault and supported attachments/links without modifying originals.

name: Evernote import
acceptance_criteria: Import supported Evernote export notes and attachments with useful metadata; report failed entries.

name: Apple Notes import
acceptance_criteria: Accept documented Apple Notes export flow, ingest documents/media and report unsupported data.

name: Instagram Saves and collection sync
acceptance_criteria: Local extension/desktop signed-in session imports selected saves; collections become tags on first import; daily and manual sync, selection backfill and disconnect behavior; login/session stays on device.

name: Workspace export
acceptance_criteria: Build asynchronous ZIP with markdown documents/cards, links.csv, source-grouped highlights and original uploads; progress, expiring download and skipped-files report; omit chats/layout/computed transcripts per documented behavior.

name: Grid and freeform canvas
acceptance_criteria: Create/rename/duplicate boards; switch views without losing items; grid sorting and canvas coordinates persist; same item can appear on multiple boards.

name: Spaces and sections
acceptance_criteria: One-level sidebar Spaces organize boards; sections segment a board; items can be added/moved and board sorting can use documented sort keys.

name: Canvas interaction
acceptance_criteria: Pan via space/right-drag, zoom, fit view, select, move and resize items; copy-paste at cursor; duplicate and Alt-drag; axis lock; escape cancel; user-local undo/redo.

name: Canvas drawing and pointers
acceptance_criteria: Pen, eraser, rectangle, text, line and arrow tools persist marks; laser pointer fades without saving; tools stay selected until changed.

name: Grid and snapping
acceptance_criteria: Toggle dot grid, snap on drag, temporarily override using modifier key; preferences persist.

name: Multiple contextual chats
acceptance_criteria: Create separate chats adjacent to sources, selected items or entire board; source relationships persist across sessions.

name: Public board sharing and duplication
acceptance_criteria: Create/revoke shareable links and allow read/comment or supported edits; recipient can duplicate accessible items into own workspace; no unshared private data travels.

name: Team and private boards
acceptance_criteria: Visibility modes restrict content to team or explicitly invited users; private board items do not become globally readable by changing views.

name: Specific-person item invitations
acceptance_criteria: Invite by email to board/note/table, assign supported view/edit permission, revoke without workspace membership; guest invites do not consume member seat.

name: Share individual item
acceptance_criteria: Share note/table/link/media independently of board; supported public view/comment/edit permission is enforced server-side; revoke is effective immediately.

name: Threaded and anchored comments
acceptance_criteria: Comments sit beside note/table/board, support replying/resolving/mentions where documented, require login to post, and obey share permission; summaries notify owners; comments do not enter AI context or exports.

name: Version history
acceptance_criteria: List snapshots, inspect and restore versions within plan retention; restoration creates recoverable state rather than silent irreversible overwrite.

name: Trash and restore
acceptance_criteria: Delete moves recoverable items into trash; restore retains useful context; plan-specific retention and permanent expiry are explicit.

name: Rich markdown documents
acceptance_criteria: Create long-form notes with headings, paragraphs, lists and blocks; slash insert menu, @ mentions, rearrange blocks, side panes and autosave; source context remains accessible.

name: Database table columns
acceptance_criteria: Rows plus text, select, multi-select, date, checkbox, priority and workspace-item relation fields; add/rename/remove columns and options; computed created/platform/likes/views; color choices persist.

name: Rows as workspace items
acceptance_criteria: Link existing item, create document/table from row, or add related item without renaming row; linked title follows original item; row deletion remains recoverable.

name: Table, list, kanban and calendar
acceptance_criteria: Same rows switch among 4 layouts; group by status/date/etc, drag between groups to edit property, reorder lanes, date calendar drag; saved filters and views persist.

name: Bulk and keyboard editing
acceptance_criteria: Enter/Tab/arrows traverse typed editors; range select supports multi-cell change, clear, copy TSV and row duplicate/remove; sorted rows disable manual reorder.

name: Recurring tasks and relative date filters
acceptance_criteria: Daily/weekday/weekly/monthly/yearly/custom recurrence; complete advances same row to next future occurrence and unchecks; optional from-completion anchor; calendar previews and undo; today/overdue filters remain relative.

name: Live embedded tables and templates
acceptance_criteria: Embed existing/new table in note with bidirectional editing; deleting block retains table; external duplicate copies table safely; create from reusable templates and AI.

name: Focused article/social reader
acceptance_criteria: Render clean articles/newsletters and full social text with saved reading position; local browser capture may be needed for paid content user can already read.

name: PDF and EPUB reader
acceptance_criteria: Upload/read PDF and EPUB, search/highlight, maintain figures/tables/layout for premium PDF extraction; retain original binary.

name: Video, reel and audio transcription
acceptance_criteria: Saved YouTube/TikTok/Instagram videos and supported uploads get readable searchable transcripts tied to source; processing/error states and language handling are visible.

name: First-class highlights
acceptance_criteria: Select passage in readable formats, create highlight with source/position and note; searchable Highlights pane; add quote card to board; reopen source context.

name: Reader narration
acceptance_criteria: Generate/play audio narration for saved reads with useful playback controls and clear availability on plan.

name: Kindle sync
acceptance_criteria: Connect through documented authorized flow, import book highlights, track sync status, dedupe and disconnect.

name: Readwise sync
acceptance_criteria: Authorized Readwise connection imports highlights and source metadata; subsequent sync updates without duplicates; disconnect revokes credential.

name: Snipd podcast highlights
acceptance_criteria: Authorized connection imports podcast snips/highlights and source context with resumable sync and disconnect.

name: Multi-platform outlier discovery
acceptance_criteria: Search/filter corpus by topic, platform, date, follower range, format and outlier floor; use seven named research platforms; browse/filter free vs typed paid search is entitlement-driven.

name: Creator-relative outlier ranking
acceptance_criteria: Outlier is post metric divided by creator recent median: likes for X/LinkedIn/Substack, views for YouTube/TikTok, separate IG content-type baselines; show sample/baseline provenance and unavailable metrics honestly.

name: Creator search and profiles
acceptance_criteria: Resolve handles and linked cross-platform profiles; semantic topic search returns excerpt evidence; top outlier/liked/viewed/shared/recent sorts; track creator data refresh.

name: Creator lists and recommendations
acceptance_criteria: Create/update lists, aggregate latest posts as refreshable feed, suggest similar creators, save standouts to boards; list differs from saved snapshot board.

name: Boost/reverse-engineer posts
acceptance_criteria: Analyze hook/structure/angle, apply pattern to user idea, generate variation/short-form angles; retain full source context and citation in resulting chat.

name: Meta and TikTok ad discovery
acceptance_criteria: Search ads with creative/copy/CTA/platform/niche/angle/format; sort running duration/rising; show run dates, variations and available TikTok CTR/views/likes without claiming true ROI.

name: Brand ads and watchlists
acceptance_criteria: Resolve brand from name/site/social/ad URL, start on-demand collection, show active/history ads, daily refresh, track in shared watchlist feed.

name: Ad variation comparison and archive
acceptance_criteria: Group variations, compare dates/placements/copy/CTA side by side; saved permitted creatives remain available independently of live campaign; save/chat/brief from ad.

name: Eve multi-tool chat
acceptance_criteria: Streaming chat can search/read/organize/write/repurpose/prepare queue in one request; tool traces visible, retriable errors concrete, progress survives background runs.

name: Grounded board/workspace chat
acceptance_criteria: Attach explicit board/item context, retrieve relevant owned material and return verifiable source lines; no unsupported claims that material was read.

name: Model selection and custom instructions
acceptance_criteria: Select available models/tier, persistent user instructions, clear credits/cost display, configured provider/model capabilities; unavailable provider is marked unavailable.

name: Multiple writing voices
acceptance_criteria: Editable voice profiles derive from user-selected sources; choose writing voice globally/per chat; migration from older prompts/identities is documented.

name: Deep Social background research
acceptance_criteria: Run bounded multi-query market investigation, real posts and source citations, progress and final report; no fake metrics when corpus unavailable.

name: Deep Synthesis
acceptance_criteria: Search/read large owned library, connect themes with exact sources, deliver background result without cross-tenant leakage.

name: Background tasks
acceptance_criteria: Delegate longer work from chat, preserve visible running/completed/failed status, cancel/retry where appropriate, notify user and reopen result.

name: Text-first image and hybrid generation
acceptance_criteria: Generate post/quote cards, visual explainers and optional AI backgrounds; editable crisp HTML/CSS text overlay; save/refine/export and attach to draft.

name: Voice-to-text capture
acceptance_criteria: Microphone capture transcribes to editable text with explicit recording state and permission flow.

name: Build a Custom AI
acceptance_criteria: CRUD name/description/instructions/starters/voice, own chat history and page; attach library files, notes, live boards or public creators; answers show used sources.

name: Narrow, live knowledge boundary
acceptance_criteria: Only attached knowledge is accessible; live board/note references reflect updates; wrong source can be corrected; creator source refresh is explicit.

name: Share and install templates safely
acceptance_criteria: Shared instructions/starters install independent copy, exclude private board/note/chat contents, replace private knowledge references with named empty slots.

name: Explore marketplace
acceptance_criteria: Search/filter categories/platforms, inspect template knowledge, install and start specialist; 19 publicly listed templates captured in report.

name: Custom AI routines
acceptance_criteria: Scheduled run inherits companion instruction/knowledge/voice in fresh chat; preserve source boundary and continuity through explicit notes.

name: Portable SKILL.md skills
acceptance_criteria: Create via form/chat, import markdown or ZIP references, handle duplicate names via replace/keep-both, read refs on demand and export byte-exact; scripts stored but never executed.

name: Slash and automatic skill activation
acceptance_criteria: Slash picker or semantic trigger activates visible removable chip per chat; built-in skills toggle workspace-wide; custom skill editing and deletion persist.

name: Nine built-in skills
acceptance_criteria: Ship Skill creator, Prompt creator, X posts, X threads, LinkedIn posts, Instagram captions, YouTube titles, Newsletter writer, Table builder as exportable read-only toggles.

name: Timezone-aware routines
acceptance_criteria: CRUD 20/workspace max documented daily/weekday/weekly/monthly schedules with model/prompt/email; preserve original timezone; skip overlapping run; persist next run and pause status.

name: Routine result inbox and notifications
acceptance_criteria: Fresh chat per run, pulsing running and blue unread completed markers, latest-week run list, clear on open; persistent note/table memory across runs; email/push result option.

name: OAuth social account linking
acceptance_criteria: Link X/LinkedIn/Threads/Instagram/TikTok/Facebook/YouTube on official auth screens, handle reconnect/revoke/errors and per-workspace/per-brand scope; IG requires professional, FB Page, YouTube Shorts only.

name: Multi-platform composer and drafts
acceptance_criteria: Store draft/master plus per-platform versions, threads, images/video/doc media, platform validation and previews; drafts never publish until explicitly scheduled/published.

name: Queue/calendar/custom schedules
acceptance_criteria: Queue into slots or explicit timezone time; best-time suggestions if supported by evidence; edit, move, cancel, reuse past post and status tracking until published.

name: Durable scheduled delivery
acceptance_criteria: Worker publishes due posts with per-platform results, retry/idempotency, failure reasons, connection expiry state and cancellation races handled; saved scheduled status must reflect actual provider result.

name: First comment and repost automation
acceptance_criteria: After successful post, schedule first comment and supported X auto-retweet/repost/quote actions with explicit user configuration and result tracking.

name: Substack local-device bridge
acceptance_criteria: Text notes/articles hand off to Substack native scheduler via signed-in extension/desktop; mark On Substack only after confirmation; image/thread note requires live browser; missed is warning/draft, never stale publish; custom domain permission.

name: Post image renderer
acceptance_criteria: Convert text to native-looking post image, select styling/aspect and identity, preview/export/attach; preserve per-platform attachments.

name: Own cross-platform analytics
acceptance_criteria: Connected private metrics sync into warehouse; totals/deltas/follower counts, per-post views/likes/shares/saves/impressions/watch time/email opens when source supports; missing is syncing/unavailable, never zero.

name: Topic/format winners and baseline comparisons
acceptance_criteria: Filters by brand/platform/window, recent top posts and own baseline, compare periods, track 30/60/90-day plan history; separate own performance from market evidence.

name: Instagram automation rules
acceptance_criteria: Trigger by comment keyword, story reply, incoming DM keyword or reaction/optional emoji; target single/next/new posts; message editor and preview; separate public reply action.

name: Webhook automation delivery
acceptance_criteria: Consume authenticated webhooks, dedupe same rule/person for 7 days, delay and respect hourly/daily platform limits, pause at zero credits and resume; count only successful actual sends.

name: Tracked short links
acceptance_criteria: Create branded short slug, redirect to editable destination, aggregate sends/clicks/CTR without exposing recipients; change destination preserves old link.

name: Custom link domain
acceptance_criteria: Verify owned domain and DNS, TLS/redirect serving, validation/errors and revoke; include default shared domain and slug collisions.

name: Business app connector catalog
acceptance_criteria: Workspace-scoped Kit, beehiiv, Klaviyo, Stripe, Whop, Kajabi, Notion, Webflow and Circle; OAuth/API-key configuration, encrypted storage, pause/delete and per-tool disable.

name: Business reads and mutations
acceptance_criteria: Read subscriber/revenue/member/page data, create broadcasts/products/posts, update CMS/pages according to each provider permissions; tool traces and content review for consequential actions.

name: Custom hosted MCP and Zapier
acceptance_criteria: Connect remote HTTPS MCP URL with API key/OAuth, discover tools lazily, per-tool enable, enforce SSRF boundaries and treat external results as data; stdio-only servers unsupported.

name: Public MCP server and OAuth
acceptance_criteria: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint, OAuth protected resource/authorization metadata, read/write scopes, workspace default/override and structured {ok:false,status,message} failures; expose permission-safe tool catalog.

name: 74 publicly catalogued MCP tools
acceptance_criteria: Implement real workspace/research/boards/tables/scheduling/media/analytics/Custom AI/skills operations; published aliases work or deprecate explicitly; tool inputs discoverable at runtime.

name: Weekly Strategist
acceptance_criteria: Save settings once; score own posts separately; bounded market investigation; up to 3 patterns each supported by different creators; grade previous bet, exactly 3 plays and one bet; save dated memo with receipts.

name: Head of Content
acceptance_criteria: Review prior plan/actual queue and metrics, reuse recent weekly memo, evidence for each slot and at most one experiment; approve slate, draft up to 7 in voice into queue, save week report and change log.

name: Content Command Center
acceptance_criteria: Connect own analytics, show real top posts, Analyst/Scout/Strategist/Planner/Repurposer stations, saved settings/snapshot, refresh and optional Telegram digest; missing metrics say syncing.

name: Personal Brand Strategist
acceptance_criteria: Interview/refresh answers, research personal-sized creators, curate 8–16 real receipt posts, positioning/story/topic tree/content directions/first five hooks/monetization, save strategy and optional approved queue drafts.

name: Idea Engine
acceptance_criteria: Fuse own saved material, live market and tangent formats; each idea has at least two legs; 5–8 cards or honest fewer; dedupe last 3 runs and queued/published; hooks in voice, evidence and approved draft action.

name: Chrome extension capture and creator sidebar
acceptance_criteria: Toolbar/right-click saves, inline buttons on X/YouTube/Instagram/Substack, chosen board/workspace, local token auth and creator sidebar; LinkedIn toolbar/profile flow.

name: Responsive web and device continuation
acceptance_criteria: Web works on mobile; native iOS TestFlight/Android APK/macOS exist publicly, but user requested web app; cross-device reading/chat continuation should work if native apps later built.
evidence: documented; native clients outside requested web artifact

name: Plans, quotas and subscription lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: Free/Personal/Personal Plus/Starter/Pro/Studio tiers; quotas on storage/upload/credits/history/tracking/brands/seats, accurate upgrades/downgrades/cancel/pause and retained data.

name: Credit ledger and usage
acceptance_criteria: Free one-time grant, paid monthly refill, metered LLM/research/tool actions, retry-safe debit/refund and concurrent reservations; transparent history; out-of-credits is actionable and does not fabricate success.

name: Invoices and tax details
acceptance_criteria: Download paid invoice/receipt, company billing name and VAT/tax ID, plan ownership and safe payment portal.

name: Seven free creator tools
acceptance_criteria: YouTube/Instagram/TikTok transcript tools, X character counter, engagement rate calculator, post image generator and YouTube app-link generator; genuine inputs/outputs and provenance.
